CustomField.description: Clickable link (opens in a new tab) to the record the rating was given on, for any object. Shows only the object name (e.g. Account); the record Id is used behind the scenes. Ratings saved before Related Object existed get the name from the Id prefix of common standard objects, else "Record".
CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(Related_Record_Id__c), "", HYPERLINK( "/" & Related_Record_Id__c, IF( ISBLANK(Related_Object__c), CASE( LEFT(Related_Record_Id__c, 3), "001", "Account", "003", "Contact", "006", "Opportunity", "500", "Case", "00Q", "Lead", "Record" ), SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(Related_Object__c, "__c", ""), "_", " ") ), "_blank" ) )
CustomField.label: Related Record
